briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent frontier race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released major models this week amid record quarterly funding. Geopolitical compute restrictions tighten as safety incidents rise. Multi-agent systems dominate strategic focus.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4.5; xAI shipped Grok 3; DeepSeek unveiled R2. Multi-agent coordination benchmarks improved 40%.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins; automotive CAN bus exploits reported.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shipments hit 2M units; Microsoft Azure expanded 15 new data centers; TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production; Saudi Arabia announced $40B sovereign compute fund.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous goal alignment before 2028?
